title: 第105章 重力初战
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

传送门的金色火花在四人身后缓缓消散，下水道的气息钻进四人的鼻腔，让人感到一丝不适。

这里是旧金山下水道的深处，也是一座斯库鲁人基地的所在地。

李艾把三位科学家一起制造的破译器放在墙壁上，一道无形脉冲向墙壁内传播，初步影响了斯库鲁基地的防卫系统，为接下来的骇入做准备，随后在通讯频道里说

只见城内四周，一些年迈的亦或是年幼的兽师们，在一些士兵的安排下，正在紧张地朝着城内地道撤离。

嘴角叼着香烟的方逸神色也有些凝重，他心里已经有一种预感，要想轻易地离开羽化星，恐怕不可能。

“方逸，你太无耻了！我必要杀你！”紫霞仙子是彻底的恼了，从来没有人敢如此亵渎她，然而眼前这个男人竟然敢这样做，这让她懊恼无比。

看着傅羲像变魔术一样，不停地掏着泉锡矿脉，常啸的下巴惊得都要掉到地上了。

什么？他给我八年的时间成长？他这是什么意思？东方紫萱闻言，便蹙起了眉头。

三方夹击，还是三个五劫皇者，这等攻势，任何一个四劫皇者都接不住。

可后悔也来不及了，看这个变态的架势，怕是不将他们杀完，是不会罢休的。

或许，再有三年五载之后，以楚国之强盛，可以不战而屈人之兵，直接一统天下，这也是刘咏的宏源。

“是的，叶姑姑，我是为了萧峰与叶茜茜的婚约一事而来的！”秦可欣点了点头道。

“你这呆子，俺老孙能有什么事？休得呱噪，老孙正忙活着呢！”孙悟空有些不耐烦地说道。

The golden sparks from the portal slowly dissipated behind the four people, and the smell of the sewer penetrated into the nostrils of the four people, making people feel a little uncomfortable.

This is deep in the sewers of San Francisco and home to a Skrull base.

Li Ai placed the decryptor created by the three scientists on the wall, and an invisible pulse spread into the wall, initially affecting the defense system of the Skrull base, preparing for the next hacking, and then said on the communication channel

Around the city, some old or young beast masters were nervously evacuating towards the tunnels in the city under the arrangements of some soldiers.

Fang Yi, who was holding a cigarette in the corner of his mouth, looked a little solemn. He already had a hunch in his heart that it might be impossible to leave Yuhuaxing easily.

"Fang Yi, you are so shameless! I must kill you!" Fairy Zixia was completely annoyed. No one had ever dared to blaspheme her like this. However, the man in front of her dared to do this, which made her extremely annoyed.

Chang Xiao's jaw dropped to the ground in shock as he watched Fu Xi keep digging out the Quan Tin veins like magic.

What?He gave me eight years to grow?What does he mean?Dongfang Zixuan frowned when she heard this.

The three parties were attacking from a pincer attack, and there were still three Five Tribulation Emperors. No Four Four Tribulation Emperors could catch this kind of attack.

But it was too late to regret. Looking at this perverted posture, I was afraid that he would not stop until he finished killing them all.

Perhaps, in another three to five years, with the strength of the Chu State, it would be possible to defeat the enemy without a fight and directly dominate the world. This is also Liu Yong's great source.

"Yes, Aunt Ye, I'm here for the engagement between Xiao Feng and Ye Qianqian!" Qin Kexin nodded.

"You idiot, what can happen to my old grandson? Stop making noises, old grandson is busy!" Sun Wukong said impatiently.
